subject: Mutual Action Plan: Acme MAP and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + Next steps from today's call (MAP draft to follow)

Jordan — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment.

Key pain points you shared:
- Current response times on your internal search/chat features regularly exceed 800ms under peak, causing drop-off in engagement.
- Cost of running existing model infra is high (GPU ops + engineering overhead).
- Auditability and data residency requirements for product logs are a must for compliance.

Goals we heard:
- Reduce median latency to sub-200ms for 90% of production queries.
- Cut per-query inference cost by ~40% through batching, quantization and caching.
- Deploy within a VPC with KMS integration to satisfy procurement/security.

Proposed high-level MAP milestones (working draft):
1) POC kickoff & data access (Target: Aug 3) — define evaluation corpus and performance SLAs.
2) POC run & evaluation (2 weeks) — perf, cost, quality metrics.
3) Pilot deployment (Target: Sep 1) — limited production traffic, monitoring and alerting.
4) Contract & procurement sign (Target: Sep 15) — finalize terms, DocuSign.

Owners (draft)
- Redwood: Marissa (AE), Nikhil (Solutions Engineer)
- Acme: Jordan (Product), Priya (Procurement), David (Security)

Open items / asks from Acme today:
- Confirmation of target POC dataset and expected QPS during the POC (can you share a sample or spec?).
- Procurement timeline and any mandatory procurement paperwork.
- Security checklist contact (David — can you confirm if the SOC2 + KMS notes we discussed are sufficient?).

I will follow up with a MAP document (attached) and a short SOW draft for procurement. Please reply with any changes to owners/timelines and we can lock the plan.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: (will attach MAP + SOW in follow-up)
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme.com>, David Chen <david.chen@acme.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + Next steps from today's call (MAP draft to follow)

Thanks Marissa — that looks great and aligns with our notes. A couple quick clarifications: 

- POC dataset: we'll aim to provide a ~5k query sample with representative traffic shape (peaks ~100 QPS) by Friday, Jul 31. I'll send the file and data spec.
- Procurement: Priya will own — typical timeline is ~2–3 weeks once SOW and pricing are finalized. Priya, I’m looping you in.
- Security: David will share the standard security questionnaire; he flagged encryption-at-rest with KMS as required plus a brief infra diagram for our audits.

Happy to move the POA dates you proposed — Aug 3 kickoff is fine. Please send the MAP and SOW and we’ll route internally.

Subject: Mutual Action Plan (v1) + SOW draft attached — please review

Hi all — attaching the MAP v1 and a short SOW draft for procurement. Summary below and a few asks to keep momentum: 

Attached: ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx (master MAP, milestones, owners)
Attached: ACME_SOW_draft.docx (pricing bands for POC/pilot and standard terms)

Recap of Milestones (from MAP v1)
- Aug 3: POC kickoff — Redwood will onboard the POC instance, establish data access, and run baseline perf tests.
- Aug 4–18: POC execution — run tests, cost profiling, and quality evals. Redwood will provide daily topline updates.
- Sep 1–14: Pilot — limited production routing (10% traffic), monitoring and canary rollouts.
- Sep 15: Contract execution — finalize SOW and sign.

Decision process & approvals
- Product sign-off (Jordan) after POC metrics meet latency/cost thresholds.
- Security sign-off (David) to confirm infra/KMS controls and SOC2 evidence.
- Procurement sign-off (Priya) for budget and contract terms.

Requested actions from Acme by Jul 31:
1) Share POC query sample and QPS profile.
2) Confirm procurement required clauses (e.g., data residency, audit access).
3) Confirm who will approve the SOW internally and expected sign date (target Sep 15).

Logistics: HubSpot MAP record has been created (link below). I can host a 30-min internal kickoff with your team and Nikhil next week if helpful.

Links & attachments:
- HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/ACME-7890
- DocuSign (SOW envelope when ready): https://www.docusign.com/mock/ACME-Map-Envelope-12345

If the timeline looks good I’ll lock the Aug 3 kickoff and send calendar invites.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — received and reviewed. Couple notes from procurement and security: 

Procurement notes:
- Standard timeline: once we have final SOW and pricing, procurement turnaround is typically 10–15 business days. Expect sign by Sep 15 is reasonable if no major redlines.
- We require a PO number before execution. I will share the PO template and a contact to add to the SOW.

Security notes (David):
- SOC2 Type II report acceptable. Please send the most recent report and an endpoint diagram showing where KMS keys are stored and who has access.

Action items from Acme (we will deliver):
- POC sample dataset + QPS profile by Jul 31 (Jordan).
- Procurement PO template and internal approver list by Aug 6 (me).
- Security questionnaire to be returned within 5 business days after receipt (David).

We’re aligned on Aug 3 kickoff. Priya will lead procurement and I (Jordan) will lead product sign-offs.

Thanks — Priya
